summary: Independent review of the unfilled-owner release after confirmed cancellation. THE DEFECT IS LIVE-MEASURED, not theoretical: FTFT on 2026-09-11 placed a first-rest order at 10:43 ET, the watchlist dropped it at 10:45 mid-episode, the owner went unknown with reason=watchlist_removed_before_position_episode_ended, and it then sat refused for FIFTY-TWO MINUTES across 611 recovery evaluations reading open=0 filled_accounts=0 position_ids=0 age_ms=0. The recovery path requires fill evidence, and an episode whose order never filled can never produce it, so the only escapes were a SELL flip or the 04:00 roll; FTFT was freed at 11:37 by [V2-FANOUT-IDENTITY-PERSISTED] segment_id=1789136282377 active=0 reason=sell_flip_flat_unknown_owner, which I traced in the live log, and it then minted a clean new opportunity and traded +5%. THE FIX IS FAIL-CLOSED BY CONSTRUCTION and the docstring states the load-bearing rule outright — 'a cancel draft is not evidence that its target left the broker' — which is the cancel-is-fire-and-forget lesson applied correctly: missing intents, still-active intents or orders, malformed identities, and ANY fill all keep an opportunity OUT of the terminal-unfilled set, and the strategy may use only membership in that set to release. Terminal statuses are cancelled/canceled/rejected/expired, a rejected intent additionally requires settlement before the FLIP_OWNER_ROW_SETTLE_MS cutoff, and the poll is scoped to exactly the unknown owners snapshotted before the DB worker runs. MUTATIONS — I mis-targeted twice and am recording that so the matrix is trusted for the right reason: my first two attempts were no-ops (a dead assignment, and widening a status set the tests never exercise) and 'survived' meaninglessly. Correctly targeted, every safety property is RED: fills no longer blocking release -> test_position_book_refuses_incomplete_or_filled_terminal_evidence fails; the settlement window ignored -> same control fails; the [V2-FLIP-OWNER-RELEASED] marker renamed -> 2 controls fail including the FTFT churn scenario and the TNON sell-flip case. The fill-blocking control is the one that matters most: releasing an episode that filled moments later is the false-flat/fill-settlement-lag class that produced a naked position on 2026-08-21, and it is pinned. Controlled full unit pair vs base 2fae102: base 46 failed/3606 passed, head 46 failed/3615 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed, compared as sorted sets. Ruff clean. Ancestor PASS. Reviewer differs from the author. ⭐ The new [V2-FLIP-OWNER-RELEASED] marker also closes a diagnostic gap I hit personally today: the transition OUT of unknown was previously unlogged on the owner's own markers, which is why I told the operator FTFT 'cannot recover' while it was three minutes from recovering. No findings; nothing withheld.
